chunks: Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn Yaḥyā, from al-Sindī ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAlāʾ, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a garment that urine reaches. He said: “Wash it in the washtub twice; but if you wash it in flowing water, then once is sufficient.”

key_terms.اغْسِلْهُ: wash it, the command to purify the garment
key_terms.الثَّوْبِ: the garment or clothing being discussed in the ruling
key_terms.الْبَوْلُ: urine, the najasah affecting the garment
key_terms.الْمِرْكَنِ: a washbasin or washtub in which the garment is washed
key_terms.مَاءٍ جَارٍ: flowing water, in which one washing suffices
key_terms.مَرَّةً وَاحِدَةً: once, the sufficient number of washings in flowing water
key_terms.مَرَّتَيْنِ: twice, the required number of washings in a container

ai.seo_question: How should a garment be purified if urine gets on it?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about purifying a garment affected by urine. It states that washing twice is required in a container, while one washing suffices if it is washed in flowing water.
